Robotics Summer School 2027

The Example Institute invites undergraduate students interested in robotics and AI systems to its annual summer school. The programme combines lectures, lab sessions and a team project.

The summer school takes place from 10 to 14 June 2027 in Berlin and is held in person.

Applications open on 1 January 2027 and close on 15 March 2027. Please prepare a CV and a short motivation letter.

Travel grants are available. Abstract submission deadline for the poster session: 1 May 2027.
